title: Rebuild derivative ledger to correct late credit overhang affecting per-model usage heatmaps
creator: Marco Liu
description: Background: Multiple tenants have reported confusing spikes and persistent overhangs in per-model usage heatmaps after shard replays and late quota-credit reconciliations. Root cause hypothesis: credit-return events generated during delayed reconciliation were being appended to the derivative ledger as additive transactions instead of being treated as neutralizing adjustments against prior charged rows. The downstream aggregations used by console heatmaps and per-model breakdowns consume that derivative ledger which produces inflated cumulative token counts and chart spikes that are visible to customers and SREs.
work_to_do: 1) Design and implement an idempotent reconciliation path that converts late credit events into corrective ledger deltas (neutralizers) rather than raw positive transactions. 2) Rebuild the derivative ledger for affected time ranges using the new reconciliation logic. 3) Update aggregation SQL/queries to prefer corrected delta semantics and add unit tests. 4) Add a watermark-based backfill strategy and a shadow run mode to validate results against current production outputs. 5) Provide a compact validation report and rollout plan; run on a canary cohort before wide rollout.
acceptance_criteria:
- Reconciled derivative ledger eliminates overhang: cumulative per-model token totals differ from production by <=1% for unaffected tenants and reduce historical spike artifacts for affected tenants by >=95%.
- Console heatmaps for canary tenants show no stepwise increases caused by late-credit inserts after replay.
- Backfill job completes within SLAs for 30-day window for a medium-sized tenant (<= 2 hours).
- Post-deploy alerts for reconciliation discrepancy >2% trigger runbook.
- Documentation and runbook updated.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Backfill could be slow and tax DB read replicas. Mitigation: shard backfill by tenant and use rate-limited windowed jobs.
- Risk: Off-by-one with event timestamps causing tombstone misapplication. Mitigation: include event_id and sequence checks and run shadow diff before swapping tables.
- Risk: Consumers (charts) depend on current ledger schema. Mitigation: maintain backward-compatible read interface and feature-flag switch to new ledger version.
implementation_notes:
- New reconciliation consumer runs in the telemetry pipeline and emits 'neutralizer' transactions with a negative token delta and a reference to original charge_id.
- Add column 'corrects_charge_id' to derivative_ledger (nullable string) to enable idempotent application.
- Backfill job will write to derivative_ledger_v2 and once validated, we will swap view derivative_ledger -> derivative_ledger_v2.
- Add comprehensive unit/integration tests and a synthetic tenant replay harness (scripts in infra/synthetic-replays).
comments: 2026-02-25 Marco Liu: Ticket created after on-call escalations from SRE. Observed symptoms: tenant 'acme' shows repeated +50k token jumps over historical time buckets after shard replay on 2026-02-20.

2026-02-27 Aisha Patel: Did an initial audit of the derivative_ledger ingestion. Found that late credit events are tagged with origin=backfill and then reprocessed as independent credits. Hypothesis: lack of corrects_charge_id causes additive behavior.

2026-03-03 SRE (Luca Romero): Ran synthetic tenant replay (script infra/synthetic-replays/replay_acme.sh). Produces identical spike pattern; evidence attached to PR. Logging shows duplicate ingest paths for backfill events where dedupe was skipped because shard_id changed.
2026-03-06 Marco Liu: Implemented prototype consumer that emits negative delta rows with corrects_charge_id. Added unit tests for dedupe using sequence+event_id checks. PR opened (see links).

2026-03-09 QA (Priya Nair): Shadow run on synthetic canary completed. Diff report: in 30-day window canary-acme cumulative tokens down 6.3% and spike count reduced from 14 to 1. Backfill runtime for 30 days: 1h48m on staging replica with concurrency=6.

2026-03-12 Aisha Patel: Prepared rollout plan: (1) run backfill for 7 high-impact tenants in staging, (2) run canary in prod for 5 tenants for 48h, (3) swap view and monitor. Added alerting thresholds for reconciliation-delta > 2%.
2026-03-14 Marco Liu: Addressed review feedback: added idempotency checks and optimized query with partition pruning. Scheduling a production canary tomorrow morning UTC.
